Licences of what vendor/aframe-1.8.0.min.js holds: A-Frame 1.8.0 itself, then every package of its
production dependency tree at the version its package-lock.json fixes (webpack bundles them; some may be
left out of the browser build, none is missing here). Texts from each package as published on npm
(unpkg.com) or, for three-bmfont-text, its GitHub commit; gathered 13.10.2026.
